summary: INT. SHARDFALL CITADEL — THE KNIFE’S EDGE — NIGHT. A dueling chamber, circular floor of black alloy scored with a single glowing line.
settingText: INT. SHARDFALL CITADEL — THE KNIFE’S EDGE — NIGHT
directionInline: A dueling chamber, circular floor of black alloy scored with a single glowing line. Banners of violet and ember flutter. Crowds roar from metal tiers. VORRIC MALVEK strides in, flamboyant, silver cloak snapping. He flourishes a shard-forged blade, tips it toward the tier of captains. He points at ELYRA VORN. Gasps ripple. Elyra steps forward, calm but burning.

summary: INT. VEIL MARKET — CAVERNS — DAY. Graffiti everywhere: arrows, chalk ships, slogans.

dialogueInline.speaker: Captain Nira Sol
dialogueInline.text: They want a fight, Jex. Give them food, not words.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex Marrin
dialogueInline.text: Food’s gone. Words are all I’ve got.

directionInline: Graffiti everywhere: arrows, chalk ships, slogans. Crowds chant, pushing guards. NIRA SOL wades in, shoving people back. JEX MARRIN on a crate, trying to calm. A bottle smashes. Riot sparks.

summary: INT. THE KNIFE’S EDGE — NIGHT. Crowds roar.

dialogueInline.speaker: Vorric Malvek
dialogueInline.text: Civilians weigh nothing. Oaths weigh nothing. Only edge.

directionInline: Crowds roar. VARRA CINDRAL sits stiff, arms folded. SIRA RED FANG leans forward, grinning. The TRIARCH masks hover above, silent. VORRIC struts the circle. ELYRA steps onto the line, blade simple, armor plain. The duel begins — sharp, sudden. Vorric flamboyant, Elyra efficient.

summary: INT. KNIFE’S EDGE — CONTINUOUS. Vorric presses harder, cloak snapping.

dialogueInline.speaker: Elyra Vorn
dialogueInline.text: One step more and you break your oath.
